notes.title: Release version patch notes
notes.notes:
Compared with alpha version, version 1.0 would have:
- 22 new types of equipment
- 12 new types of rooms
- 3 difficulty levels (Casual, with choosing of starting equipment and weaker enemies, Normal - that little easier than in alfa, Leper - where character is infected from start). 2 different endings
- Added the opportunity to hear the voice of mushrooms and have a talk with an ancient monolith
- Now when you fight you have an option not to wait until animation of attack preparing is ended, you can realise attack on 75% of animation, but the damage will be decreased.
- You can fight with you right hand when equiped only left hand weapon.
- More help hints for player
- Improved video settings (Shadow amount, enable physics, draw distance, Brightness)
- 26 Steam achievements
- Machine of clear mind
- Balance improvements
- Many little bug-fixes
- Some music was replaced(
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27934814/a9c364a1773a2b092c2072abaaf2e4de2a18a2fe.png
 Many thanks for providing us your feedback!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27934814/0445ed72e7bda90e6fae4ff622e3db9760110150.png
